chunks: From him, from his father, from Ibn Mahbub, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, the ghurrah may increase and decrease, but its value is forty dinars.

key_terms.تَزِيدُ: it increases; it may be greater in some instances
key_terms.تَنْقُصُ: it decreases; it may be lesser in some instances
key_terms.دِينَارًا: dinars; a gold currency unit used for legal valuation
key_terms.قِيمَتُهَا: its value; its fixed legal monetary worth
key_terms.ٱلْغُرَّةَ: the ghurrah; a legally assessed compensation category in this context

ai.seo_question: What is the prescribed value of the ghurrah in Shia hadith law?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the valuation of the ghurrah, indicating that while it may vary in some respects, its established monetary value is forty dinars. The report is relevant to jurisprudential discussions on compensation and rulings related to الحمل and related legal matters.
